# BarStyle

> **File:** `config/BarStyle.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for Bars.style: how every bar draws its widgets, accents and shadow, unless its own style sets a key (Bar.lookOf). Previews of the Bars section show live (the bar editor's).

### Properties

- `values` (readonly var): The style's values by key ({ fontSize, widgetRadius, widgetStyle, …, shadow: { enabled, color, size } }), as a bar's own would be
- `look` (readonly var): The look surfaces draw their shadow in, the way a bar's look is (Bar.lookOf): the style with its shadow as flat shadow / shadowColor / shadowSize
- `shadowed` (readonly bool): Whether surfaces cast the shadow
